stem_book: Three blocks are connected as shown in the figure on a smooth horizontal table: wall — spring 1 (k) — block A (3m) — spring 2 (k) — block B (2m) — light string over a smooth pulley at the table edge — block C (m) hanging. The system is in equilibrium. Find the acceleration of block A if spring (2) is cut suddenly. (a) g/3 (b) g/2 (c) g/6 (d) none
work: Equilibrium: both springs carry mg; cut spring 2 → only spring 1 (mg) acts on A: a_A = mg/3m = g/3
